title: Factors in finite groups and well-covered graphs
summary: We study a combinatorial property of subsets in finite groups that is analogous to the notion of independence in graphs. Given a group $G$ and a non-empty subset $A\subset G$, we define a (right) $s$-factor as a subset $B\subset G$ satisfying the following conditions: (i) Every element of $AB$ can be written uniquely as $ab$ with $a\in A$ and $b\in B$. (ii) $B$ is maximal (with respect to inclusion) with this property.
